name: Blood (Paragon Hag Family)
body:
The soucouyants or blood hags are known for their deceit as much as their control over fire. Their paragon hag families command dangerous fire magic and treacherous illusions.

Family Spells: burning hands (3rd), scorching ray (6th), deep slumber (9th), greater invisibility (12th), fire shield (15th), mislead (18th).
Ritual Spells – Bluff: extended fly (5th), seeming (7th), swarm skin (9th), mass fly (11th), mind blank (13th), elemental swarm (fire only) (15th), extended fiery body (17th), empowered sympathetic* destruction (19th).
Family Powers: Blood paragon hags have souls of fire, but are all the more dangerous due to their normal appearance.
Masked Presence (Su)

You appear as a specific young human woman (or young woman of another race appropriate to your background at the GM’s discretion) chosen when you gain this ability. While wearing this false skin, you count as humanoid of the appropriate subtype for all spell effects. The skin also guards you with undetectable alignment.

You cannot use your claws through the skin, but can discard the false skin as a move action. Fitting yourself back into the skin requires the cast-off skin and one minute.

The false skin absorbs damage when you are attacked, taking damage up to twice your level before it is destroyed. Any additional damage carries through to you as normal. If your false skin is damaged this way or otherwise lost, it regrows the next time you regain spells and any cast-off skin rots away.

Skin Trickery (Su)

At 4th level, you may spend a soul point as part of a minute-long ritual over the recent corpse of a humanoid of your size category. This fully heals your false skin, replacing your normal appearance with that of the dead humanoid (providing a +10 bonus on Disguise checks to pass yourself off as that creature) until this skin is destroyed, you use this ability again, or you next prepare spells.

Fiery Form (Sp)

At 8th level, you can assume a form of living fire as the spell elemental body I (fire elemental only) by spending a soul point as a standard action. At 12th level, this works as elemental body II. At 16th level, it works as elemental body III. And at 20th level, it works as elemental body IV. Taking fiery form while wearing your false skin destroys the skin.

Erupting Flame (Su)

At 12th level, you may spend a soul point when dismissing your fiery form ability. If you do, the flames explode outward, dealing 12d6 fire damage in a 30 foot radius around you (Reflex halves). This damage increases by 1d6 fire damage for each Paragon Hag level after 12th. The Reflex DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your paragon hag level + your Charisma modifier.

Advanced Trickery (Su)

At 16th level, any form you take with the skin trickery ability reacts to divinations as though it were the original creature at the time of its death. For example, detect good will determine whether the creature was good and discern lies will find falsehood only if the original creature would have been lying.

Legendary Family

Upon reaching 20th level, you have gained mastery of your forms. While wearing a false skin, you gain DR 10/cold iron and magic that you can suppress or activate as a free action. In fiery form, you now count as incorporeal and your slam attacks are treated as incorporeal touch attacks. In your true hag form, your claws gain the keen and flaming burst weapon enchantments.
